description: A begginer team of 6 members which are studying industrial enginieering.
summary: Our main goal is to get people to know more about lost projects on space. We intend to make these stories as enjoyable as possible for enabling the little ones to understand how we know whats there on the outer space. By doing said video we would provide children with an entertaining and educational way to get them excited about the wonderful space. We wanted to convey basic knowledge about the universe, encourage curiosity and learning, and show that learning can be fun.
details: The video is an educational video for children, its purpose is to educate them about human garbage in space. It is expected that, although it will not have a huge impact, it will raise awareness among some part of the young population. The entire story has been created by our team, with real data from both robots. To do this we consider all the information we find on the NASA website.
